songs.title: 프렐류드
songs.sp: Neoclassical chamber instrumental for six cellos only — no other instruments. D major, 64 BPM, 4/4. Serene, warm and unhurried — gentle background music as guests are seated. Cello 1 (highest) sings a simple calm melody in soft legato with light vibrato; Cellos 2 and 3 hold warm sustained inner harmony; Cellos 4 and 5 add slow arco swells; Cello 6 (lowest) rests on a deep, quiet pedal tone. At the warm center all six cellos come together in soft, full sustained chords, moving as one before separating again into gentle voices. Peaceful, understated, loopable. Natural concert-hall reverb.
songs.bracket:
[Intro]
[solo Cello 1, soft legato melody over Cello 6 deep pedal tone, hushed]

[Theme]
[Cellos 2 and 3 add warm sustained inner harmony, Cello 1 continues the calm melody]

[Interlude]
[all six cellos come together in soft full sustained chords, the ensemble breathing as one, warm and gentle]

[Theme]
[voices separate again, Cello 1 restates the melody over warm six-part harmony, unhurried]

[Outro]
[decrescendo, the six cellos settle together onto a soft sustained D major chord, fading]
songs.form: Intro → Theme → Cellos 2 and 3 add warm sustained inner harmony, Cello 1 continues the calm melody → Interlude → Theme → Outro

songs.title: 입장
songs.sp: Neoclassical chamber instrumental for six cellos only — no other instruments. D major, 72 BPM, 4/4. Radiant, noble and ceremonial — the bride's entrance. It opens hushed and intimate, then builds to a powerful full-ensemble climax where all six cellos play together in rich, massed block chords. Cello 1 (highest) carries a soaring noble melody in singing legato with warm vibrato; Cello 2 weaves a countermelody a third below; Cellos 3, 4 and 5 fill rich inner harmony with double stops; Cello 6 (lowest) anchors deep pedal tones. At the peak the six cellos lock together and the melody rings out doubled in octaves. Stately, romantic, cinematic. Natural concert-hall reverb.
songs.bracket:
[Intro]
[solo Cello 1, hushed noble melody over Cello 6 soft pizzicato, intimate]

[Build]
[Cello 2 enters with countermelody, Cellos 3 and 4 add sustained harmony, slow crescendo]

[Theme]
[Cello 1 melody soars, Cello 5 joins inner harmony, Cello 6 walks measured pizzicato, full and warm]

[Climax]
[all six cellos lock together in rich massed block chords, the melody doubled in octaves, radiant fortissimo — full ensemble as one]

[Outro]
[warm decrescendo, the six cellos settle together onto a glowing D major chord]
songs.form: Intro → Build → Cello 2 enters with countermelody, Cellos 3 and 4 add sustained harmony, slow crescendo → Theme → Cello 1 melody soars, Cello 5 joins inner harmony, Cello 6 walks measured pizzicato, full and warm → Climax → Outro

songs.title: 서약
songs.sp: Neoclassical chamber instrumental for six cellos only — no other instruments. G major, 58 BPM, 4/4. Solemn, intimate and sacred — the exchange of vows. The six cellos play con sordino, muted and hushed, in long sustained legato. Cello 1 (highest) speaks a simple reverent melody; Cello 2 answers in gentle imitation; Cellos 3, 4 and 5 hold a warm sustained pedal of inner harmony; Cello 6 (lowest) grounds deep still bowed notes. At the vow's peak the mutes lift and all six cellos swell together in one full, radiant chord — a sealed promise — before returning to hushed stillness. Sacred, unhurried, profound. Natural concert-hall reverb.
songs.bracket:
[Intro]
[all six cellos con sordino, hushed muted sustained chord, Cello 1 speaks a simple reverent phrase]

[Theme]
[Cello 1 and Cello 2 in gentle call-and-response, muted legato, Cellos 3-5 sustain inner harmony, Cello 6 deep still bowed notes]

[Climax]
[mutes lift, all six cellos swell together in one full radiant chord, the whole ensemble ringing as one — a sealed promise]

[Outro]
[con sordino returns, hushed decrescendo onto a serene G major chord]
songs.form: Intro → Theme → Cello 1 and Cello 2 in gentle call-and-response, muted legato, Cellos 3-5 sustain inner harmony, Cello 6 deep still bowed notes → Climax → Outro

songs.title: 축하
songs.sp: Neoclassical chamber instrumental for six cellos only — no other instruments. G major, 118 BPM, a lively 6/8. Bright, joyful and celebratory — smiles and applause. Cello 6 (lowest) keeps a buoyant pizzicato bassline; Cello 5 adds off-beat pizzicato sparks; Cellos 3 and 4 trade quick spiccato figures; Cello 2 answers with bright pizzicato; Cello 1 (highest) darts a lilting joyful melody in airy arco with occasional harmonics. On the refrain all six cellos join together, the melody doubled in octaves over a full, dancing ensemble. Effervescent, sparkling, weightless. Natural concert-hall reverb.
songs.bracket:
[Intro]
[Cello 6 buoyant pizzicato bassline, Cello 5 off-beat pizzicato sparks, light and bouncing]

[Theme]
[Cello 1 lilting joyful melody in airy arco, Cellos 3 and 4 trade playful spiccato counterpoint]

[Refrain]
[all six cellos join together, melody doubled in octaves over a full dancing ensemble, bright and unified]

[Interlude]
[voices separate, melody tossed between Cello 1 and Cello 2, translucent pizzicato interplay]

[Climax]
[full ensemble in quick sparkling unison figures, accelerando, joyful]

[Outro]
[bright laughing cadence, final crisp pizzicato chord together]
songs.form: Intro → Cello 6 buoyant pizzicato bassline, Cello 5 off-beat pizzicato sparks, light and bouncing → Theme → Cello 1 lilting joyful melody in airy arco, Cellos 3 and 4 trade playful spiccato counterpoint → Refrain → Interlude → Climax → Outro

songs.title: 새 출발
songs.sp: Neoclassical chamber instrumental for six cellos only — no other instruments. E-flat major, 76 BPM, 4/4. Warm, full-hearted and forward-moving — the newlyweds walk out together. Cello 1 (highest) sings a broad generous melody in full legato with warm vibrato; Cello 2 weaves a countermelody with rich double stops; Cellos 3, 4 and 5 fill lush sustained inner harmony; Cello 6 (lowest) walks a striding pizzicato turning to deep pedal tones. The piece builds to a luminous climax where all six cellos ring together in full six-part chords, the melody doubled in octaves — a warm sendoff — before a settled glowing close. Romantic, expansive, radiant. Natural concert-hall reverb.

[Climax]

[Outro]
[decrescendo, the six cellos sustain a settled glowing E-flat major chord together, fading]

songs.title: 서약 (밝은 버전)
songs.sp: Neoclassical chamber instrumental for six cellos only — no other instruments. D major, 66 BPM, 4/4. Warm, luminous and joyful — a bright, hopeful exchange of vows bathed in light. The six cellos play open and singing, no mutes, in warm flowing legato with gentle vibrato. Cello 1 (highest) sings a tender, luminous melody; Cello 2 answers in warm imitation; Cellos 3, 4 and 5 fill glowing sustained inner harmony; Cello 6 (lowest) grounds a warm resonant bass. At the vow's peak all six cellos bloom together in one full, glowing major chord with double stops — a joyful promise sealed in light — before easing into a warm, smiling close. Bright, tender, luminous. Natural concert-hall reverb.

[all six cellos bloom together in one full glowing major chord with double stops, the whole ensemble ringing bright as one — a joyful promise]

[Outro]
[warm decrescendo, cellos settle together onto a glowing, smiling D major chord]
